purpose: Builds a par yield curve from caller-supplied benchmark points (at least 2, strictly increasing tenors; no live data, the caller's points are used exactly as given) under a named, versioned interpolation, linear (linear@1) or monotone cubic Hermite with Fritsch-Carlson 1980 tangents (monotone_cubic_hermite@1), and reports the G-spread of a bond against that curve: the interpolated benchmark yield at the bond's maturity and (bond yield minus benchmark yield) x 100 in basis points. A bond maturity outside the benchmark tenor range is refused naming the range, never extrapolated. Every assumption is named in plain sentences in the output. Exclusions: no bootstrapping of zero rates, no day-count, no live Treasury feed.
